label: NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1 — Guide for Conducting Risk Assessments
citation: NIST Special Publication 800-30 Revision 1 (September 2012), Appendix G (likelihood) and Appendix H (impact) assessment scales
body: NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1 provides the generic qualitative risk-assessment ladder used by this wizard for both scales: a five-step ordinal scale — Very Low, Low, Moderate, High, Very High — for assessing the likelihood of a threat event and the magnitude of its impact. The appendix tables define each step with representative descriptions, and the guide combines likelihood and impact to arrive at a level of risk. The five-step ladder is NIST's; ISO/IEC 27005 supports qualitative consequence/likelihood scales generally but leaves the number of levels to the organization.
